review_comments.body: **Canceled responses use wrong spelling** For either cancellation finish reason, this branch emits `status: "cancelled"`, but `Response.Status` and the existing cancellation aggregation test use `"canceled"`. Clients checking for `"canceled"` will not recognize this result as canceled. Accept both finish-reason spellings, but emit `"canceled"` and update the new test.
